paragraphs.source_en: Whether you agree with our assessment or not, we think you should at least accept that this stuff matters. The framework we have for human behavior in space will shape settlement every bit as much as the technology available. Understanding how international law works and combining it with your knowledge of what space is like gives you a chance to think about how space ought to be governed. Although things are changing rapidly, humanity is still in the earliest days of space settlement. We can still make choices, and those choices may have consequences that echo for centuries.
